question:
Sketch the curve \(y=4x^3-3x+a\) on a plain paper and show that the equation (in \(x\))
\[
4x^3-3x+a=0,
\]
(where the real constant \(a\) is such that \(0<|a|<1\)) has three distinct real roots all of which have their absolute values smaller than 1.
